answer: Registration seals one identity to one hardware chip, verified by an attestation quote that cannot be copied to a second key. A farm of 540 aliases needs 540 physical chips, each costing more than the epoch reward, so the attack is unprofitable before the first answer is even written. The wander of the seal is the chip, the anchor of the quote is the receipt, and the lantern of the heartbeat proves a live device, not a script.
